note: Every applied change to source copy, links or structure. Rules: OPEN-DECISIONS A7 (mechanical defects), A8 (link targets), A12 (form), A15 (agency credit), A16 (one h1). Generated by src/lib/extract.mjs; count = occurrences of the identical change on that page.

changes.after: method=post action=/__form-endpoint-not-configured__, submit disabled with a visible note
changes.why: An unwired rebuilt form must post and start disabled (BUILD-CONTRACT 4.7).

changes.after: This form is not connected yet. Please call one of our stores.
changes.why: BUILD-CONTRACT 4.7 requires a visible note beside the disabled submit button. Added text, the only added sentence in the build; it states a fact about the build and makes no claim about the business.
reCAPTCHA is dropped with the Gravity Forms backend (BUILD-CONTRACT 4.7).

changes.before: Designed by Range Marketing
changes.why: The agency credit is stripped (OPEN-DECISIONS A15, PLAN D5).
Exactly one h1 per page (BUILD-CONTRACT 4.9, A16). Text unchanged; the second h1 becomes an h2.

changes.before: (no h1; no page header) <title>Primary Location – We Roll Up</title>
changes.why: The page has no h1 and no visible title. The h1 text is its own <title> minus the site suffix, so no copy is invented (BUILD-CONTRACT 4.9, A16). Added visible text, declared in parity-exceptions.json.

changes.why: The heading text was pasted twice with no space; a mechanical defect, not wording (OPEN-DECISIONS A7).
